research.notes: The link between the legal name and the Building Maps website rests on a business directory (Buzzfile) plus the agenda's own dba statement and matching phone, city and service. No Michigan LARA or SAM.gov registry record was checked, so no entity number or UEI is given. Buzzfile gives a street address of 6541 13 Mile Rd NE, Rockford, MI 49341; the P.O. box from the company's contact page is used here.

profile.summary: Building Maps is a company in Rockford, Michigan that designs emergency and safety maps for buildings. Its products include fire evacuation maps, security maps, campus maps and severe weather maps. It serves schools, manufacturers, healthcare centers, offices and apartment complexes.
